content_html:
Watched #JAWAN : if you are SRK fan then #Pathaan was just a starter where as JAWAN is a proper full fledged yummy in your tummy SOUTH INDIAN TREAT because all of a sudden SRK tried to be a RAJINI and its a pure MASSY TREAT to fans 🙏🙏🙏

Tough Vijay Sethupathi and Nayantara shined well and did excellent job but at the end its only SRK steals the show kyon ki woh BAAP hai 😉

Tough BGM was good but it didn’t meet the standards set by Anirudh himself 😢

Special mention of the one liner dialogues which give full kick to the fans 🙏🙏

Content wise it looked like during lockdown SRK has watched various South Indian Movies and got inspired to do a Message Oriented Movie on :

1. Bank Frauds like Mahesh Babu’s Sarkaru Vaari Paata

2. Worst Conditions of our Government Health Care System like Venkatesh’s Ganesh

3. Importance of Voting for Right Candidates like Vijay’s Sarkar

4. Cute Father & Daughter sentiment movie like Vijay’s Theri

5. Massy Father & Son Dual role commercial like Vijay’s Bigil

6. Massy movie surrounded by Girls like Vijay’s Bigil

so he called Atlee who is the director of Theri and Bigil and he made a Commercial Kichidi content with a plot covering main points from all the above movies treated with a typical Atlee’s Screenplay and Direction and Bang we have one of the best commercial movie for SRK Ready 😍🤣

for a regular audience of South Indian Movie this film offers nothing new except for the treat if watching SRK doing an out and out commercial

One thing for sure is this movie will definitely open doors for Top South Indian Directors to work with Top Bollywood Stars…..
